    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">TOON 协议与 AIDotNet.Toon 实践指南</span>
    

</a>

        </div>
        <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>一、TOON 是什么</p>
<p>官方定义要点摘录（来源：toon-format/toon 仓库 README）：</p>
<ul>
<li>Token-efficient：通常比 JSON 少 30–60% 的 tokens（Key Features 列表）</li>
<li>LLM-friendly guardrails：显式长度与字段，便于验证</li>
<li>Minimal syntax：移除冗余标点（大括号、方括号、许多引号）</li>
<li>Indentation-based structure：类似 YAML，以空白缩进代替大括号</li>
<li>Tabular arrays：一次声明列头，数据按行流式书写</li>
</ul>
<p>官方基准与工具：</p>
<ul>
<li>README 的 Benchmarks 表格展示了多个数据集下的 token 节省比例；此外提供“Format Tokenization Playground”可交互比较不同格式的 token 用量</li>
<li>当前规范版本：v1.3（README 徽章与 SPEC.md 指向的专用仓库）</li>
</ul>
<p>规范入口与一致性：</p>
<ul>
<li>规范迁移至独立仓库：<a href="https://github.com/toon-format/spec%EF%BC%88SPEC.md" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/toon-format/spec（SPEC.md</a> 明确“moved to a dedicated repository”）</li>
<li>跨语言一致性依赖 conformance tests（README 的 Other Implementations 区块提供说明）</li>
</ul>
<p>二、为什么 TOON 相比 JSON 更省 tokens</p>
<p>本质原因是“以结构换冗余”：在 LLM 语境下，重复的键名和标点都会占用 tokens。TOON 通过以下策略显著减少冗余（均可在 README 与语法速查中找到实例）：</p>
<ul>
<li>表格数组：为均匀对象数组声明一次列头，如 users[2]{id,name}: 后续行直接写 1,Alice</li>
<li>行内原子数组：tags[3]: a,b,c，避免多余方括号与引号</li>
<li>键名可不加引号：安全键裸写，减少引号数量</li>
<li>缩进代替大括号：以空白表达层级</li>
</ul>
<p>同时，官方 README 也清晰指出边界：对于深度嵌套或非均匀结构的数据，JSON 可能更高效。这意味着在“树深且分支不规则”的任务上应优先评估 JSON。</p>
<p>三、语法速查与对照示例</p>
<p>下列示例与含义对应自 README 的 Syntax Cheatsheet 与“Why TOON”示例（术语与格式请以规范 v1.3 为准）：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>对象<br>
{ id: 1, name: 'Ada' }  →  id: 1  换行  name: Ada</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>嵌套对象<br>
{ user: { id: 1 } }  →  user: 换行缩进 id: 1</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>行内原子数组<br>
{ tags: ['foo', 'bar'] }  →  tags[2]: foo,bar</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>表格数组（均匀对象）<br>
{ items: [ { id: 1, qty: 5 }, { id: 2, qty: 3 } ] }<br>
→  items[2]{id,qty}: 换行缩进 1,5 换行缩进 2,3</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>混合或非均匀数组<br>
{ items: [ 1, { a: 1 }, 'x' ] }  →  items[3]: 换行缩进 - 1 换行缩进 - a: 1 换行缩进 - x</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>四、AIDotNet.Toon：.NET 实现概览</p>
<p>AIDotNet.Toon 对齐 upstream 规范与设计，面向 .NET 提供与 System.Text.Json 风格一致的 API。关键入口如下：</p>
<ul>
<li>序列化： <a href="src/AIDotNet.Toon/ToonSerializer.cs:14" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">C#.ToonSerializer.Serialize()</a> · <a href="src/AIDotNet.Toon/ToonSerializer.cs:22" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">C#.ToonSerializer.Serialize()</a></li>
<li>反序列化： <a href="src/AIDotNet.Toon/ToonSerializer.cs:33" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">C#.ToonSerializer.Deserialize()</a> · <a href="src/AIDotNet.Toon/ToonSerializer.cs:44" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">C#.ToonSerializer.Deserialize()</a></li>
<li>编码实现： <a href="src/AIDotNet.Toon/ToonEncoder.cs:13" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">C#.ToonEncoder.Encode()</a></li>
<li>解码实现： <a href="src/AIDotNet.Toon/ToonDecoder.cs:15" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">C#.ToonDecoder.DecodeToJsonString()</a></li>
<li>选项模型： <a href="src/AIDotNet.Toon/ToonSerializerOptions.cs:28" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">C#.ToonSerializerOptions</a> · 分隔符枚举 <a href="src/AIDotNet.Toon/ToonSerializerOptions.cs:9" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">C#.ToonDelimiter</a> · 默认实例 <a href="src/AIDotNet.Toon/ToonSerializerOptions.cs:99" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">C#.ToonSerializerOptions.Default</a></li>
<li>错误模型： <a href="src/AIDotNet.Toon/ToonFormatException.cs:9" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">C#.ToonFormatException</a></li>
</ul>
<p>实现思路（节选自源码注释与 README）：</p>
<ul>
<li>Encode 路径：.NET 对象 → JsonElement → Encoders 结构化写出（对象、行内原子数组、表格数组、列表回退等）</li>
<li>Decode 路径：TOON → 规范化 JSON 字符串 → System.Text.Json 反序列化为目标类型</li>
<li>数值与特殊值：允许命名浮点字面量，经编码阶段将 NaN 与 ±Infinity 规范化为 null，-0 规范化为 0（细节见编码器与选项）</li>
</ul>
<p>五、安装与快速开始</p>
<p>通过 NuGet（发布后）或源码引入本库：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">dotnet add package AIDotNet.Toon
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">using AIDotNet.Toon;

var options = new ToonSerializerOptions
{
    Indent = 2,
    Delimiter = ToonDelimiter.Comma,
    Strict = true,
    LengthMarker = null
};

var data = new
{
    users = new[] { new { id = 1, name = "Alice" }, new { id = 2, name = "Bob" } },
    tags = new[] { "a", "b", "c" },
    numbers = new[] { 1, 2, 3 }
};

var text = ToonSerializer.Serialize(data, options);
// users[2]{id,name}:
//   1,Alice
//   2,Bob
// tags[3]: a,b,c
// numbers[3]: 1,2,3
</code></pre>
<p>读取原子值：</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var s = ToonSerializer.Deserialize&lt;string&gt;("hello", options);   // "hello"
var n = ToonSerializer.Deserialize&lt;double&gt;("3.1415", options);  // 3.1415
</code></pre>
<p>互操作：TOON ↔ JSON ↔ .NET</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">// 将 TOON 文本转为目标类型，内部先经 [C#.ToonDecoder.DecodeToJsonString()](src/AIDotNet.Toon/ToonDecoder.cs:15)
var user = ToonSerializer.Deserialize&lt;Dictionary&lt;string, object&gt;&gt;("id: 1", options);

// 将 .NET 对象经 JSON DOM 编码为 TOON
var t = ToonSerializer.Serialize(new { id = 1, name = "Ada" }, options);
</code></pre>
<p>六、选项与行为</p>
<p>统一选项入口 <a href="src/AIDotNet.Toon/ToonSerializerOptions.cs:28" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">C#.ToonSerializerOptions</a> 与默认预设 <a href="src/AIDotNet.Toon/ToonSerializerOptions.cs:99" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">C#.ToonSerializerOptions.Default</a>：</p>
<ul>
<li>Indent：每级缩进空格数，默认 2</li>
<li>Delimiter：分隔符，枚举 <a href="src/AIDotNet.Toon/ToonSerializerOptions.cs:9" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">C#.ToonDelimiter</a>，用于行内与表格；底层转换为具体字符见 <a href="src/AIDotNet.Toon/ToonSerializerOptions.cs:66" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">C#.ToonSerializerOptions.GetDelimiterChar()</a></li>
<li>Strict：严格模式，校验缩进、空行、计数一致性等</li>
<li>LengthMarker：数组长度标记，仅支持 # 或 null</li>
<li>JsonOptions：直通 System.Text.Json；默认启用 AllowNamedFloatingPointLiterals，并注册转换器以将 NaN 与 ±Infinity 写出为 null</li>
</ul>
<p>七、错误模型与定位</p>
<p>解码错误统一抛出 <a href="src/AIDotNet.Toon/ToonFormatException.cs:9" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">C#.ToonFormatException</a> 并包含错误分类与位置信息：</p>
<ul>
<li>工厂方法：Syntax <a href="src/AIDotNet.Toon/ToonFormatException.cs:45" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">C#.ToonFormatException.Syntax()</a> · Range <a href="src/AIDotNet.Toon/ToonFormatException.cs:55" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">C#.ToonFormatException.Range()</a> · Validation <a href="src/AIDotNet.Toon/ToonFormatException.cs:65" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">C#.ToonFormatException.Validation()</a> · Indentation <a href="src/AIDotNet.Toon/ToonFormatException.cs:75" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">C#.ToonFormatException.Indentation()</a> · Delimiter <a href="src/AIDotNet.Toon/ToonFormatException.cs:85" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">C#.ToonFormatException.Delimiter()</a></li>
</ul>
<p>八、进阶示例</p>
<ol>
<li>表格数组写出</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var rows = new[] { new { id = 1, name = "alice" }, new { id = 2, name = "bob" } };
var toon = ToonSerializer.Serialize(rows, options);
// [2]{id,name}:
//   1,alice
//   2,bob
</code></pre>
<ol start="2">
<li>行内原子数组</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var arr = new[] { 1, 2, 3 };
var t2 = ToonSerializer.Serialize(arr, options); // "[3]: 1,2,3"
</code></pre>
<ol start="3">
<li>混合数组回退为列表</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var mixed = new object[] { 1, new { a = 1 }, "x" };
var t3 = ToonSerializer.Serialize(mixed, options);
// [3]:
//   - 1
//   - a: 1
//   - x
</code></pre>
<p>九、何时使用 TOON，何时选 JSON</p>
<p>基于官方 README 的定位：当你的数据是“均匀对象数组、字段重复较多、需要给 LLM 更大输入上下文”时，TOON 通常更省 tokens 且更易校验验证；当数据“深度嵌套、非均匀或树形变化大”时，JSON 可能更高效更直接。</p>
<p>十、数据流与实现关系图</p>
<p><img src="https://files.mdnice.com/user/40104/bc0cdaef-e3b0-409f-8217-5218c3fbad99.png" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>十一、来源与参考</p>
<ul>
<li>官方仓库与 README：<a href="https://github.com/toon-format/toon" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/toon-format/toon</a></li>
<li>规范仓库 v1.3：<a href="https://github.com/toon-format/spec" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/toon-format/spec</a></li>
<li>README“Key Features”“Benchmarks”“Syntax Cheatsheet”“Other Implementations”板块提供了本文引用的特性描述、节省比例与示例</li>
<li>本文 .NET 实现地址：<a href="https://github.com/AIDotNet/Toon.NET" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/AIDotNet/Toon.NET</a></li>
</ul>
<p>十二、结语</p>
<p>TOON 让 LLM 输入里的结构化数据更加紧凑、可校验、可读；AIDotNet.Toon 则在 .NET 世界提供熟悉的 API 体验与选项模型。建议从表格数组与行内原子数组的典型场景开始落地，并结合规范 v1.3 与测试数据持续验证。</p>
<p>Special thanks to the upstream project toon-format.</p>
<p>附：官方 Benchmarks 数据集节选</p>
<p>以下数字直接摘录自官方 README 的 Benchmarks「Token Efficiency」小节，原文与上下文见：<a href="https://github.com/toon-format/toon#benchmarks%EF%BC%88%E5%85%B6%E4%B8%AD%E6%8F%90%E7%A4%BA%E8%BF%99%E4%BA%9B%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E9%9B%86%E5%81%8F%E5%90%91" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/toon-format/toon#benchmarks（其中提示这些数据集偏向</a> TOON 的优势场景：均匀表格化数据，真实效果取决于数据结构）。交互式对比工具：</p>
